notes: A new look that matches the web app: the same colours, typeface, sidebar, page headings and words as the web pages, Debit in red and Credit in green, figures written with a comma every three digits (611,256), and a dark mode that reads properly. The detail pane now opens beside the list on a 1366 laptop, forms fit a small window, and Urdu text is drawn whole. Figures follow the web's rules in the cashbook, balance sheet, bills tracking and the dashboard's cash in hand, and sale bills include the tax adjustment. The app now goes quiet after ten minutes with nobody at the keyboard or mouse, and while minimised, and syncs at once on the next click or key press, so a PC left on overnight no longer keeps the online database awake. Your keyboard shortcuts work as before.
